# Fixtures

All files here were written for this project. Nothing is collected from third parties.

- `insan/` holds human-register reference texts, written in a natural human register per genre. They are not machine-written, and they are not samples from real publications. Rules must stay silent on them.
- `sadakat/` holds before and after pairs written for the project. The "after" text must not add a fact the "before" text lacks.
- The AI-style samples (`ai-metin-*.md`) are written to show typical machine patterns.
- `tdk-ornekler.txt`, `yanlis-bicimler.txt` and `maskeleme.md` are test cases for TDK forms and for masking code and quotes.

Rules for new files: one file per case, UTF-8, LF line endings.
